fullPassage: Most people have no doubt heard this question: If a tree falls in the forest and there is no one there to hear it fall, does it make a sound? The correct answer is no. Sound is more than pressure waves, and indeed there can be no sound without a hearer. And similarly, scientific communication is a two-way process. Just as a signal of any kind is useless unless it is perceived, a published scientific paper (signal) is useless unless it is both received and understood by its intended audience. Thus we can restate the axiom of science as follows: A scientific experiment is not complete until the results have been published and understood. Publication is no more than pressure waves unless the published paper is understood. Too many scientific papers fall silently in the woods.

ch: 많은 논문이 자연과 숲을 주제로 다룬다.

많은 나무가 종이를 만드는 데 사용된다.
많은 논문이 이해·수용되지 못한 채 아무 영향도 남기지 못하고 묻힌다.

questions.passage: Most people have no doubt heard this question: If a tree falls in the forest and there is no one there to hear it fall, does it make a sound? The correct answer is no. Sound is more than pressure waves, and indeed there can be no sound without a hearer. And similarly, scientific communication is a two-way process. Just as a signal of any kind is useless unless <u>it is perceived</u>, a published scientific paper (signal) is useless unless it is both received and understood by its intended audience. Thus we can restate the axiom of science as follows: A scientific experiment is not complete until the results have been published and understood. Publication is no more than pressure waves unless the published paper is understood. Too many scientific papers fall silently in the woods.
questions.stem: 위 글에서 밑줄 친 it이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: it = a signal(신호)
det.analysis:
밑줄 위치: Just as a signal of any kind is useless unless it is perceived

❌ ① 논문: 논문은 뒤 절(a published paper ~)의 주어로, 이 절과 무관.

✅ ② 신호(a signal): 앞의 주어 a signal of any kind를 받는 대명사. '신호는 인지되지 않으면 쓸모없다'. 정답.

❌ ③ 소리: 이 절의 주어가 아님.

❌ ④ 나무: 앞 문단의 비유 소재로 이 절과 무관.
det.tip: a signal ... unless it is perceived — it = a signal

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 소리 비유와 마찬가지로 과학적 의사소통(scientific communication)도 양방향이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① pressure waves(압력파): is a two-way process의 주어로 부적절.

❌ ② the correct answer(정답): 양방향 과정의 주체가 아님.

✅ ③ scientific communication(과학적 의사소통): And similarly, scientific communication is a two-way process — 소리 비유를 과학 소통에 적용하는 핵심 문장. 원문 일치.

❌ ④ intended audience(의도된 독자): 소통의 한 쪽 대상일 뿐 주어로 부적절.
det.tip: similarly로 소리→과학 소통을 연결 (둘 다 양방향)
